buildings.title: Shanghai Grand Opera House by Snøhetta
buildings.name: Shanghai Grand Opera House
buildings._asked: The artist, 21 Oct 2026, sending a LinkedIn link (lnkd.in, refused to the session) and then: "It's the new Shanghai Opera house building by Snohetta"; asked whether to add it though it is not in the Architectural Authority (its own search, HybridSearch/Global, finds nothing for Shanghai Grand Opera, Snøhetta, opera house or Pudong; its sitemap has no article on it): "Add it by hand".
_sources: Point: OpenStreetMap way 1316877742 (amenity=theatre, name:en Shanghai Grand Opera House, name 上海大歌剧院), its centroid by Nominatim (lookup?osm_ids=W1316877742), 31.1806072 N, 121.4663783 E. A public building: exact. Not the Shanghai Grand Theatre at People's Square (way 39763758).
Year: opened 17 October 2026 (zh Wikipedia, read through api.wikimedia.org: 10月17日啟用); built from 18 December 2019, completed 23 June 2026 (zh Wikipedia).
Link: Snøhetta's own project page, the address as search results give it; the session's proxy refuses snohetta.com, so it was not opened from here.
Wikidata Q85873917 (opera house, Shanghai); Expo Culture Park, Pudong, beside the Huangpu.
